scope: Read-only design review of DISCOVERY-EXPANSION-DESIGN-R1. No source, schema, test, Git, connector, Vault, or network mutation.

preview_storage.safety: Retained no-follow descriptors, complete family scans, create-only atomic install, exact bytes/inode/link checks, and final verification on normal and exception exits.

preview_contracts.identity: rw1:<kind>:SHA256(JCS({schema_version,kind,data})); reference sha256 is SHA256(complete document plus one LF).
preview_contracts.graph: Observation->request, metadata->request+observation, preview->metadata, decision->preview+previous decision; discovery uses a separate rw3 registry.

research_contracts.reuse: Bounded strict JSON, UTF-8, duplicate-key/non-finite rejection, exact integer handling, JCS/LF serialization, and video_paper_wiki.staging helpers.

proposed_storage.boundary: A sibling of W1 preview-v1; never reuse W1/manual-PDF/source-catalog/Vault/CWD paths.

serialization.file_hash: SHA256(complete UTF-8 canonical document plus exactly one LF)
serialization.reference: {id,sha256}, typed and resolved only inside the declared session
serialization.filename: <content_sha256>.json for every discovery kind; sequence is a data field, avoiding W1's single decision filename chain.
serialization.limits: max family files 256; seeds 3; round plans 8; requests 32; observations 32; results per observation 256; candidates 256; one normalized payload 1 MiB; total normalized payload 16 MiB; JSON depth 32. Limits include pending/orphan artifacts and are checked before install.

object_rules.config: Immutable query decomposition, five lenses, provider profiles, rank/RRF parameters, caps, stop thresholds and precedence; no round/session refs.
object_rules.session: Immutable safe session identity, config_ref, one-to-three canonical seed descriptors and bounded topic facts; no first/last round ref or mutable HEAD.
object_rules.round_plan: Session/config binding, sequence, previous completed event (null only for first), and sorted complete request_specs with request_key commitments.
object_rules.request: Canonical connector/operation/seed/query/page/cursor/select fields plus session_id, plan_id and request_key. Retry carries exact predecessor observation ref and reason.
object_rules.observation: One terminal outcome for one request ref with executor/profile/outcome, normalized payload, visible locator, ordinal results, completeness and unavailable transport facts.
object_rules.candidate: Deterministic one-round identity proposal with complete why-found tuples, stable IDs/crosswalk facts, relation/version/mirror data and request/observation refs; no user decision.
object_rules.rank: Deterministic provider-local lists and rational RRF projection with rank config, candidate refs, explanations and canonical tie-break.
object_rules.stop: Deterministic complete-input projection with candidate/rank/observation refs, all matched reasons, metrics and precedence-selected primary reason.
object_rules.round_event: Last committed object: exact plan, previous event, request refs, one terminal observation per request, candidate/rank/stop refs, cumulative budget_after and next_action. No child points to this current event.
object_rules.candidate_decision: Append-only explicit choice/refusal after a completed round; never included in that round event.
object_rules.control_event: Append-only user_stop/resume event with supplied event_id, exact instruction text/reference, prior control ref and optional completed round ref; separate from calculated stop.

cycle_break.problem: A plan containing exact request refs while requests contain full plan refs is a content-hash cycle before either is sealed.
cycle_break.rule: The plan commits canonical request_specs and request_key values. plan_id is computed from those specs; requests carry plan_id and request_key, not a full plan ref. The validator recomputes exact spec equality. The round event is the first exact request-ref set.
cycle_break.membership_proof: Every derived child carries plan_id, sequence and input_set_sha256 over sorted exact refs. The event repeats and verifies those sets. A valid orphan child without an event remains pending and cannot authorize a successor.

edges: Only a plan points to a previous completed event; only the event points to the current plan and complete child set.
Observation->request; candidate->request/observation; rank->candidate; stop->complete input set. No lower layer points upward.
Exactly one first plan and one successor per completed predecessor. Multiple plans, outcomes or projections are conflicts.
Cross-session refs, wrong typed IDs, mismatched file hashes and aliases refuse. W1 handoff is a separate explicit operation.

interrupted_write_and_resume.writer_model: Create-only immutable objects; no mutable HEAD, database, overwrite, rename repair or automatic deletion.
install_order: Install config/session if absent or byte-identical.
Install one round plan with all request_specs and plan_id.
Install exact requests; each staged request consumes a slot even if never executed.
Accept terminal observations; each binds one request and consumes an observation slot. Missing observation is pending, never empty success.
After every request has one terminal observation, derive/install candidate/rank/stop projections; existing bytes must equal deterministic re-derivation.
Verify complete sets, budget, graph and retained edges; install round event last atomically.
Re-scan and verify every family/descriptors on normal and exception exits.
resume_rules: Read-only status creates no missing ancestor and reports absent, pending, complete, conflict or unsafe.
Resume validates the entire graph and finds at most one pending plan. It fills only missing deterministic artifacts and never edits bytes or chooses between competing plans/results.
A pending request is connector work. Failure/timeout/rate-limited observations remain terminal evidence; no hidden retry or cursor walk.
A retry is a new request in a later explicit plan with predecessor observation ref and reason; it consumes a fresh slot and cannot mutate the predecessor.
Before-event interruption leaves pending. Atomic event install leaves either no event or a complete event. Event-present/input-missing is integrity refusal.
Foreign siblings, extra plans, duplicate outcomes, reordered sets, stale bytes, symlinks, special files and replacements dominate ordinary errors and are never cleaned.
Identical bytes are idempotent; competing plans/outcomes/projections are explicit conflicts.
interrupted_write_and_resume.retention: Hold checkout/.work/research/session/discovery-v1, every family descriptor, first classifier observation, complete family set and each originally absent target through cleanup.

budget_accounting.principle: Derive counters from the immutable graph and repeat them as budget_after in each event; mismatch refuses. No refund for failure, interruption, retry or orphan work.

counters.rounds_planned: Every round plan including pending; rounds_completed counts events only.
counters.requests_planned: Every request artifact including pending and retries.
counters.pending_requests: requests_planned minus requests with exactly one terminal observation.
counters.observations_recorded: Every terminal observation, including failure, timeout, rate_limited and partial.
counters.retries: Requests with retry_of_observation_ref; each consumes a fresh request slot.
counters.normalized_bytes: Exact UTF-8 payload bytes across all stored payloads, including partial and retry observations; unavailable/failed payloads contribute zero.
counters.results: All result records; enforce per-observation and total caps before installation.
counters.candidates_materialized: All candidate artifacts including pending orphan projections; separately dedupe identities for ranking.
counters.family_files_and_bytes: Every named entry and serialized byte, including pending artifacts.

budget_accounting.eligibility: A round event requires one terminal observation per planned request and matching candidate/rank/stop complete input sets. A pending plan cannot consume completed-round metrics or authorize a successor.
budget_accounting.check: Before staging request/retry/observation, recompute prior usage plus prospective artifact. Provider per_page and cursor rules are checked before handoff.

provider_and_identity_freeze.request: Generate HTTPS api.openalex.org targets only from structured fields; one search mode, bounded ASCII URL <=4094 after encoding, per_page <=100, no arbitrary URL, credentials, authorization or account fields.
provider_and_identity_freeze.cursor: Continuation carries exact predecessor observation ref and canonical query/filter/seed/field fingerprint. New cursor must equal prior next_cursor; mismatch, reuse, changed query or absent cursor refuses.
provider_and_identity_freeze.outcome: At most one terminal observation per request. Missing capability is stored failure, never empty success. Retry-after is evidence only; no process retry.
provider_and_identity_freeze.identity: Order-independent components use exact OpenAlex/arXiv/DOI IDs and explicit crosswalk edges. Title similarity cannot merge. Conflicting same-namespace IDs stay visible and block W1 handoff until resolved.
provider_and_identity_freeze.independence: Freeze canonical mirror/independence keys and an explicit unknown state before ranking; mirrors add no independent-source weight.

blocking_freeze_decisions.issue: The prior schema list has research-round-event but no round-plan object.
blocking_freeze_decisions.required: Add research-round-plan.v1 or explicitly define its sealed commitment in session; this review recommends the new schema.

blocking_freeze_decisions.issue: User stop/resume controls require durable events but no control schema is listed.
blocking_freeze_decisions.required: Add research-control-event.v1 and keep it separate from calculated research-stop-decision.v1.
Freeze request-spec/request_key/plan_id commitments and prohibit plan request refs; event is first exact request-ref set.

blocking_freeze_decisions.issue: Pending request and retry accounting is underspecified.
blocking_freeze_decisions.required: Freeze staged reservation, terminal observation count, no refunds, retry predecessor/reason, orphan consumption and later-plan-only retries.
Freeze plan_id, sequence and complete input_set_sha256 on candidate/rank/stop; orphans remain pending until event.

blocking_freeze_decisions.issue: Discovery control/candidate streams cannot reuse W1's single decision chain.
blocking_freeze_decisions.required: Use separate discovery-v1 storage and content-hash filenames for every discovery kind; validate streams by data fields.

blocking_freeze_decisions.issue: Identity conflict and source-independence representations remain semantic.
blocking_freeze_decisions.required: Freeze component IDs, crosswalk evidence, conflict details, version relations, mirror keys and unknown independence.

blocking_freeze_decisions.issue: W1 handoff is not an artifact edge in the discovery graph.
blocking_freeze_decisions.required: Freeze whether candidate-decision stores only selected identity or optional exact rw1 ref; never auto-create W1 selection from ranking.

storage_recovery: Interruption after every install step; resume gives identical bytes and one event.
Missing event, foreign orphan, duplicate outcome, competing plan and stale/reordered sets refuse without deletion.
Parent/family replacement, symlink, hardlink, FIFO, permissions, byte, set and exception races fail closed.
graph_semantics: Three seeds, references/citations/related/topic/project, cursor continuation and retry across rounds.
Conflicting OpenAlex/arXiv/DOI IDs, versions, crosswalks, mirrors and unknown independence.
Parallelism 1/N and observation permutations give byte-identical projections.
budget_stop: Pending/failed/partial/retry/zero-result and byte-cap vectors with no refunds or divide-by-zero.
All stop reasons/precedence, consecutive metrics, user_stop then explicit resume, status around interruption.
boundary: Malformed/oversized/deep/duplicate-key/non-finite JSON, arbitrary URLs, cursor mismatch, unknown names, cross-session refs, no egress and no Vault/catalog writes.
Installed resource parity and held-out host observation; no live payload copied into fixtures.

remaining_gates: Architect must freeze successor schemas, enums, IDs, limits, CLI/API and allowlist.
OpenAlex/platform access, transport facts, authentication, completeness and semantic relevance remain external or human gates.
No builder dispatch or source implementation is authorized by this review alone.
